data.title: 猫猫 · 夜市药草茶的闻香
data.description: 猫猫穿着外出襦裙，在药草茶摊前端起小杯闻香；她用指尖拨开杯沿的香叶，确认不是可疑配方后才小口品尝，蓝瞳里闪过满意的亮光。
data.location: evening herb market outside the palace
data.action: 夜市茶摊先闻香拨开香叶，确认安全后小口品尝露出满意亮光
data.lighting: warm red lantern light after sunset
data.mood: 药师式的夜市美食勘验
data.promptProse: After sunset, she holds the small cup near her lips with one hand and draws the aromatic leaf aside with the other, a satisfied glance warmed by the red market lanterns.
data.animaCaption: One hand holds the cup near her lips as the other draws the leaf aside.
